text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, micafungin sodium injection is listed by FDA as To Be Discontinued. Par Health, USA LLC discontinued the product with an initial posting date of 2026-09-11. Corvale East holds 192 vials of 20 mg/mL (13.3 days) and 216 vials of 10 mg/mL (14.5 days). Corvale General holds 512.45 units (31 days) and 486.22 units (30.2 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1236639 of Zydus Lifesciences Limited (FEI 3013712903), the plant identified on our product label, ended on 2024-04-23 and was classified OAI with 10 observations including absence of written procedures and validation lacking for sterile drug products. A Warning Letter was issued to Zydus Lifesciences Limited on 2024-08-29 following the OAI inspection. A Class III recall (D-0596-2024) for micafungin for injection 100 mg/vial manufactured for Northstar Rx LLC was initiated on 2024-07-02 due to cross contamination with other products.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately two to four weeks at present usage. No alternative supplier is currently qualified. The FDA shortage list reflects the Par Health discontinuation; other manufacturers are not listed as short.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate Baxter Healthcare Corporation, Biocon Pharma Inc., Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc. USA, and Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. for emergency purchase; P&T Committee must approve any new source.
2. Buyer to request allocation data and lead times from each candidate supplier; Pharmacy Director must approve purchase commitments.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list daily for status changes; Pharmacy Director must be notified of any new discontinuances.

Not recommended: Initiating therapeutic alternatives or dose changes without P&T Committee review and approval.
